info.title: PayU OAuth 2.0 API Collection
info.description: OAS 3.0 standard collection for PayU OAuth 2.0 authentication using client credentials grant

post.description:
OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials Grant Token Request

This endpoint is used to obtain an access token using the client credentials grant type. The token can then be used to authenticate subsequent API requests.

**Parameters:**
- client_id: Your OAuth 2.0 client identifier
- client_secret: Your OAuth 2.0 client secret
- grant_type: Must be 'client_credentials'
- scope: The requested scope (read_payment_links)

**Response:**
Returns an access token that should be used in the Authorization header for authenticated requests.

client_id.description: This parameter contains the public identifier of the client to access the platform.

client_secret.description: This parameter contains a unique secret of client for authorization.

grant_type.description: This parameter contains a constant value used to get the access token.

scope.description: This parameter contains the purpose of the access token. For more information, refer to Additional information for request parameters table above.
